title_en: Fall 2026 ANCHOR Scholarships for Outstanding International STEM Graduate Students
summary: The Seoul National University ANCHOR Project Group is selecting international graduate students in science and engineering for two scholarship types. Students who wish to be recommended by the department for the Tuition One-Time Support Type must email the required documents to the department office by 11:00 on Wednesday, 30 September 2026. Students applying for the Academic Subsidy Type (Education and Research Scholarship) apply individually by email to the ANCHOR Project Group at any time until the budget is used up; the email addresses are in the original notice.
applies_to: Application is voluntary and has two types. Tuition One-Time Support Type: graduate students paying their own Fall 2026 tuition who are foreign graduate students (foreign nationality) admitted from Fall 2025 onward, with a previous-semester GPA of 2.7 or higher, who can submit a research and study plan related to AI or robotics, and who paid tuition at their own expense without any on-campus or off-campus tuition support. Academic Subsidy Type (Education and Research Scholarship): international graduate students in science and engineering.

dates.what: Deadline to email documents to the department office to request a department recommendation (Tuition One-Time Support Type only)
Application deadline for the Tuition One-Time Support Type (the department sends an official letter to the ANCHOR Project Group)
Application period for the Academic Subsidy Type (Education and Research Scholarship)
dates.when: Rolling applications until the budget is used up

conditions: Tuition One-Time Support Type: you must be a foreign graduate student (foreign nationality) admitted in Fall 2025 or later.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: your GPA for the previous semester must be 2.7 or higher.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: you must be able to submit a research and study plan related to AI or robotics.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: you must have paid your tuition at your own expense, without any on-campus or off-campus tuition support.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: the award covers only the self-paid portion of Fall 2026 tuition.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: you cannot apply directly; the department sends the application to the ANCHOR Project Group by official letter.
Academic Subsidy Type: applications are accepted only until the budget is used up.
The TOPIK incentive (actual test fee and a score-based incentive of up to KRW 3,500,000) is only for ANCHOR recipients.
All documents must be submitted as a single zip file named with your English name.
steps: Tuition One-Time Support Type: Read Attachment 1 (ANCHOR Global Talent Scholarship Program Plan) to check the required documents; the attachments were not read for this translation.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: Prepare all documents listed in Attachment 1 and combine them into one zip file named with your English name.
Tuition One-Time Support Type: Email the zip file to the department office (address in the original notice) by 11:00 on Wednesday, 30 September 2026, to request a recommendation.
Academic Subsidy Type: Read Attachment 2 (ANCHOR Education and Research Scholarship Program Plan) and Attachment 4 (application forms); the attachments were not read for this translation.
Academic Subsidy Type: Complete form 4a (Application Form) and form 4c (Program Participation Plan) from Attachment 4, and obtain your transcript for the previous semester.
Academic Subsidy Type: Combine all documents into one zip file named with your English name.
Academic Subsidy Type: Email the zip file individually to the ANCHOR Project Group (address in the original notice) before the budget is used up.
translation:
Fall 2026 ANCHOR Project Group Scholarship for Outstanding International Graduate Students in Science and Engineering

The Seoul National University ANCHOR Project Group is selecting recipients of a scholarship for outstanding international graduate students in science and engineering. Eligible students are encouraged to apply.

Students who wish to be recommended for the Tuition One-Time Support Type should send the relevant documents to [email address; see the original notice] by 11:00 on Wednesday, 30 September 2026.

[Table; columns: Tuition One-Time Support Type (등록금 일시지원 유형) | Academic Subsidy Type: Education and Research Scholarship (학업보조금 유형 교육ㆍ연구장학금)]

Target
- Tuition One-Time Support Type: graduate students paying their own Fall 2026 tuition.
- Academic Subsidy Type: international graduate students in science and engineering.

Main details
Tuition One-Time Support Type:
1) Eligibility
- International graduate students (foreign nationality) admitted from Fall 2025 onward
- Previous-semester GPA of 2.7 or higher
- Able to submit a research and study plan related to AI or robotics
- Paid tuition at their own expense without any on-campus or off-campus tuition support
2) Benefit: Fall 2026 tuition (self-paid portion)

Academic Subsidy Type:
Student Ambassador
- [Information Session Ambassador] Online information session: KRW 100,000 per session; offline: KRW 200,000 per session
- [SNU Promotion] Online mentor: KRW 100,000 per month; offline campus tour: KRW 100,000 per session
TOPIK incentive (ANCHOR recipients only)
- Actual cost of the test fee
- Incentive according to score level (up to KRW 3,500,000)
Global Networking
- International graduate student council or international student meeting: KRW 100,000 per session
- Mentor-mentee program: KRW 100,000 per session
- Running a career/start-up club and submitting activity reports: KRW 200,000 per month
- Domestic volunteer activity: KRW 200,000 per session

Required documents
- Tuition One-Time Support Type: [Attachment 3] ANCHOR scholarship recommendation list; check the required documents listed in [Attachment 1] and submit them all as one zip file (file name: English name); [Attachment 1] Program Plan is also announced to students.
- Academic Subsidy Type: [Attachment 2] and [Attachment 4] are announced so that interested students in the department can apply individually. Submit form 4a_Application Form and form 4c_Program Participation Plan from [Attachment 4], plus your previous-semester transcript, all as one zip file (file name: English name).

Application method
- Tuition One-Time Support Type: the department sends an official letter to the ANCHOR Project Group.
- Academic Subsidy Type: individual application by student email ([email address; see the original notice]).

Application deadline
- Tuition One-Time Support Type: Wednesday, 30 September 2026
- Academic Subsidy Type: rolling applications (until the budget is used up)

Attachments (4) (their contents were not read for this translation):
- Attachment4_Scholarship_Application_Forms_KR-EN-ANCHOR.zip
- Attachment 1. ANCHOR Global Talent Scholarship Program Plan (KR&EN).hwpx
- Attachment 2. ANCHOR Education and Research Scholarship Program Plan (KR&EN).hwpx
- Attachment 3. ANCHOR Scholarship Recommendation List (department form).xlsx

Contact details are given in the original notice.
